patch_description: Replace the CRX-heavy entangling ansatz with a compact, symmetry-aware CZ-based block that (1) reduces circuit depth and gate count, (2) preserves expressive power through group-shared single-qubit rotations (corners/edges/center), and (3) keeps parameter efficiency by sharing parameters across symmetric qubits. This aims to improve generalization (lower train-test gap) and raise test accuracy by lowering depth/complexity while keeping key center–periphery links. The replacement uses only allowed gates and the existing grid adjacency.
